title: Pipewright environment manifest (written by the platform side, read by the ML side)

run_requests_topic.description: Pub/Sub topic for run requests from inside the perimeter (pushed to the launcher's /pubsub/run); used instead of calling /run when set

runtime.description: cloud_run (default): the launcher is a Cloud Run service fed by push subscriptions; gke: a Deployment in the cluster (private-gke) that pulls the same subscriptions

audiences.description: every name the launcher answers to (ID token audiences): its Cloud Run URL and its name in the cluster, so releases built under either runtime keep working

retraining.description: platform limits on retrain decisions in this environment

required_approvers.description: approver groups every use case must include (e.g. model risk)

bqml.description: platform limits on BigQuery ML use cases in this environment (validate enforces them)

max_bytes_billed.description: the most bytes one BigQuery ML job may bill; the default limit when a use case sets none

ai_forecast.description: allow bqml.forecast.engine ai_forecast (AI.FORECAST with Google's TimesFM model), the one exception to C-08; off unless true (Pipewright 1.1)

images.description: approved image allow-list (Pipewright 1.1): the base images and package indexes a use case's images may be built from; validate and release refuse anything else

base_images.description: patterns (fnmatch) every base image must match: component, Ray and synthetic images

package_indexes.description: the pip indexes requirement files may name; the first is used when a file names none; direct references are refused

default_base_image.description: the base of the component and synthetic images instead of python:3.11-slim (for example a mirror)

synthetic.description: platform limits on synthetic data in this environment (validate enforces them)

allowed.description: false: no use case may switch synthetic data on here

differential_privacy_for.description: purposes whose every candidate must train with differential privacy

gates.description: floors: a use case's gate is raised to this when it is looser (quality gates too)

required_approvers.description: approver groups that must approve a synthetic release before it leaves (Pipewright Enterprise)

outputs_uri.description: where use cases of this tenant may write GCS outputs (ends with /)

decision_feed.description: subscription with this tenant's retrain decision events (use cases opt in with retraining.decisions.publish)

kubernetes_service_account.description: orchestrator kfp: the Kubernetes service account this tenant's runs and Ray clusters use (Workload Identity binds it to the runner)

ray.description: this tenant's Ray settings, over the environment's

features.description: the feature datasets this tenant's use cases may read (data.features_from)

events_topic.description: Pub/Sub topic for Pipewright lifecycle events

log_sinks.description: informational: where the platform routes logs (e.g. dynatrace)

evidence_dataset.description: BigQuery dataset with lifecycle events and audit logs (evidence packs)

evidence_uri.description: write-once location for evidence packs (ends with /)

security.description: private profiles: applied by Pipewright to every pipeline job, model and endpoint it creates

kms_key.description: CMEK key for pipeline jobs, models and endpoints

network.description: VPC that pipeline jobs peer with (projects/<number>/global/networks/<name>)

reserved_ip_ranges.description: Private Services Access ranges for pipeline jobs

perimeter.description: informational: the VPC Service Controls perimeter

bigquery_kms_key.description: CMEK key for BigQuery query results (required when the CMEK organization policy covers BigQuery)

approver_groups.description: registered approver groups: a member approves by publishing to the group's topic, so IAM on the topic decides who belongs (any Google group, user or service account)

requires.description: the Pipewright versions this manifest needs, as a version specifier (for example ">=0.5"); older versions refuse it with a clear message

kubernetes.description: orchestrator kfp (private-gke): the GKE cluster's Kubernetes API, called as the caller's Google identity

dns_endpoint.description: the cluster's DNS endpoint (a host name, IAM authorized): for callers outside the VPC, such as a Fleet View collector

ca_certificate.description: the cluster's CA certificate, base64 PEM

namespace.description: where Kubeflow Pipelines runs and Ray clusters run

cluster.description: the GKE cluster's resource name (evidence reads its node disk keys, secrets key and network)

schedules.description: where use cases' schedules (triggers.schedules) run; without it: Cloud Scheduler jobs that call the launcher

backend.description: cloud_scheduler: a Cloud Scheduler job per schedule; kubernetes: a CronJob per schedule in the cluster (private-gke), which publishes the run request to launcher.run_requests_topic

namespace.description: kubernetes: the namespace for the CronJobs (only the scheduler's service account is there)

service_account.description: kubernetes: the Kubernetes service account the CronJobs run as (bound to an identity that may only publish run requests)

image.description: kubernetes: the image the CronJobs run (one with Pipewright: the launcher image), pinned by digest

run_as_user.description: kubernetes: the user ID the CronJobs run as (the image's non-root user; default 10001, the launcher image's)

kserve.description: private-gke: KServe for use cases with model.serving.target kserve

mirror.description: image mirror in the environment's registry (serving images from elsewhere are pulled from it)

service_account.description: the Kubernetes service account model servers run as (bound to the tenant's read-only serving identity)

exposure.description: cluster: reached inside the cluster; internal_lb: also an internal load balancer in the VPC

ray.description: Ray on Vertex AI clusters for use cases' Ray steps (optional; without it: a cluster per run, the runner identity, a prebuilt image, public endpoint, small limits)

enabled.description: false: no Ray clusters in this environment (or for this tenant)

mode.description: per_run: a cluster per Ray step of a run, created and deleted by the launcher; standing (private-gke): the tenant's long-lived, autoscaling cluster (standing.address), which steps submit to

image.description: base image for use cases' Ray images (default: the prebuilt Ray on Vertex AI image)

network_attachment.description: Private Service Connect interface for clusters (private environments)

limits.description: what a use case's Ray step may ask for

max_workers.description: most worker nodes in one cluster

machines.description: machine types allowed for head and worker nodes

max_minutes.description: longest a cluster may live; cleanup removes it after this plus a grace period

standing.description: mode standing: the tenant's cluster, kept by the platform

address.description: the head's dashboard address inside the cluster

features.description: Feature tables for use cases' data.features_from (optional; without it any table the runner can read)

required.description: models in this environment must take every feature from data.features_from

datasets.description: project.dataset of each feature dataset the tenant may read; feature tables elsewhere are refused

online_store.description: the tenant's Feature Store online store (Bigtable): use cases with model.serving.features online read their features from its views (Pipewright 1.1)
